title: Operations account review
objective: Help an operator identify the highest-priority account, understand the evidence boundary, and start the right action without losing the full ledger
task: Find the highest-priority account, inspect why it is first, then choose Review evidence
invariants: North account is the highest-priority object
The signal is stale and requires human review
Review evidence is the primary action
The full account ledger remains available

variants.label: A · Command first
variants.hypothesis: Lead with one explicit object, reason, evidence boundary, and action
variants.tradeoff: The ledger starts lower on the page

states.name: default
states.expected: North, the stale signal, and Review evidence are visible

states.name: evidence-open
states.expected: Secondary evidence opens without hiding the object or action

variants.label: B · Queue detail
variants.hypothesis: Keep queue position visible while evidence follows the selected account
variants.tradeoff: The split workspace uses more horizontal space

states.name: north-selected
states.expected: North and its stale signal are selected by default

states.name: south-selected
states.expected: Selecting South changes detail while queue context remains

variants.label: C · Ledger first
variants.hypothesis: Keep the comparison table dominant and expand evidence inside the priority row
variants.tradeoff: The primary problem competes with dense row content

states.name: default
states.expected: North is pinned as the first ledger row

states.name: row-expanded
states.expected: Evidence expands in place while the ledger header remains visible
